## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install stable-marl in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure stable-marl package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to stable-marl
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/stable-marl):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/stable-marl.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/stable-marl)

``` sh
$ conda install -c Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh stable-marl
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/stable-marl/)

``` sh
$ pip install stable-marl
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/stable-marl)’s
[pages](https://Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh.github.io/stable-marl/). Additionally
you can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/stable-marl) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/stable-marl/) respectively.
